verdict.rationale: Floot's editor-and-preview docs describe a preview pane with Desktop, iPhone, Pixel, iPad and resizable Responsive frames. Users can point at elements in it for the assistant, and can send a development preview link that opens without login, so a pre-publish live preview exists. However, the evidence never explicitly says the preview is fully interactive (clicking through flows, live backend data) or that it updates live as the AI edits. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the in-editor preview is interactive and running against the live backend, confirmation that it hot-updates during builds, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can interact with a live preview of my app while building, before publishing
